name: Kuroseiya no Uta
source:
December 25 is nigh.
The Black Santa girl Merry Nico takes on her first job of the holy night.
Together with her admired senior, Clalaus,
she races through the human world to punish naughty children.


A night of chilling discipline.
The bells toll for all.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11701]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
12月25日快到了。
黑人圣诞老人女孩梅里·尼科 (Merry Nico) 开始了她在圣夜的第一份工作。
和她敬佩的前辈克拉劳斯一起，
她在人类世界中奔跑，惩罚顽皮的孩子。


一个令人毛骨悚然的纪律之夜。
丧钟为所有人敲响。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11701]Novelgame[/url]]
